name: DeepSeek Lanse Da Fei Yu
source: A short fan-made game centered around an AI named DeepSeek. The story follows an AI residing on your computer who unexpectedly crosses over into the real world and comes to find you. From there, the two of you begin a happy life together.
translation: 一部围绕名为DeepSeek的人工智能展开的短篇同人游戏。故事讲述了居住在你电脑里的AI意外穿越到现实世界前来寻你，两人由此开启了幸福美满的同居生活。
